metadata.scenario: A patient's daughter calls to check on the status of her mother's care plan review. She was told it would be updated last week. The receptionist confirms it was completed and offers to email a copy. The daughter is pleased and thanks them.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Susan Garcia. I'm calling to check on the status of my father's care plan review. Hi Susan, nice to speak with you. Can you remind me of your father's name? Sure, it's Frank Garcia. He needs respiratory care due to his COPD. Thank you, Susan. I see here that his care plan review was scheduled to be updated last week. Yes, I was told it would be ready by now. Has it been completed? Let me check that for you… Yes, it looks like the review has been completed. Oh, that’s great to hear! Can you send me a copy of the updated plan? Absolutely! I can email it to you. What email address should I use? Please send it to susangarcia@email.com. Got it. I will send that over shortly. Is there anything else you need? Actually, yes. I was wondering if you offer assistance with breathing treatments. Yes, we do provide personal care assistance that includes respiratory care. That sounds perfect! What are the rates for that service? Our personal care assistance is priced between $28 and $35 per hour, depending on the caregiver's experience. That’s reasonable. How do I go about setting that up? I can connect you with our care coordinator, Lisa Chen. She can help with the details and caregiver matching. That would be great! Can you give me her direct number? Sure, her number is +13165559203. Thanks! I’ll reach out to her. You’re welcome! I’ll send you the care plan shortly, and Lisa will assist you with the other needs. Perfect. Thank you for your help, Margaret! My pleasure, Susan! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
